siteMetadata.description: Lab website for COCONUT Computer Club at Makassar, Indonesia

node.title: IDSECCONF 2025 - Indonesia IT Security Conference
node.venue: Ballroom Menara Pinisi, Gedung Phinisi, Universitas Negeri Makassar (UNM), Makassar
node.description: COCONUT hosted IDSECCONF 2025, the annual Indonesia IT Security Conference, held in Makassar under the theme "Cybersecurity for the Next Evolution: Society 6.0". The event featured two days of seminars, panel discussions, pre-conference workshops (November 6-7) and a Capture The Flag (CTF) competition, opened with a keynote by Ir. Budi Rahardjo, M.Sc., Ph.D.

node.title: COCONUT Open Class Batch 8 - Go REST, Go Fast: Membangun REST API dengan Golang
node.description: In collaboration with Indigo Telkom Indonesia, COCONUT Computer Club held Open Class Batch 8, a hands-on backend REST API training using the Go programming language that also introduced Apilogy, Telkom Indonesia's API marketplace. The class was led by Musdalipa and Syahrul Ramadhan with Ahmad Fajrul as moderator, and attended by more than 20 students and young developers from Makassar.

node.title: Coconut Open Class - Belajar Dasar Website dengan SvelteKit
node.description: A Coconut Open Class (COC) session on the basics of website development using SvelteKit, a modern MIT-licensed framework for faster and lighter web development, presented by Awaluddin. Part of COCONUT's regular open class series focused on building IT skills, the session targeted IT students as well as high school (SMA/SMK) students and was open to the general public.

node.title: COCONUT Alumni Meetup - What! You Need to Know Before Becoming an Engineer
node.description: A talk series for college students and fresh graduates featuring eight COCONUT Computer Club alumni: Nurkholish Halim, Profesional Cybersecurity, on "Understanding The Digital Work Environment"; Bayu Mahendra, Database Engineer at OVO, on "Multi-model highly available database"; Recky Phiter, Sr. Software Engineer at DANA, on "Becoming a FinTech developer"; Iqbal Nasikin, Security Testing Compliance at Gojek, on "Professional Pentester vs Bug Hunter"; Muh Akbar, System Engineer at GVM Networks, on "Deploying Microservices & CI/CD Best Practices"; Muh Iqbal H, Security Engineer at LinkAja, on "How to start a career in cybersecurity"; Darmawan S, UI/UX Designer at Blue Bird Group, on "How Important is UI/UX Design in the Digital Products"; and Yaomal, System Engineer at Docotel, on "Scalable Cloud Infra with OpenStack+CEPH".

node.title: Full Dissclosure 2014 - Seminar Keamanan Teknologi Informasi Opensource
node.description: A 20-hour open-source information security seminar organized by COCONUT Computer Club, featuring "Teknologi Sistem Operasi Open Source dari Masa ke Masa" by Tasrif Hasanuddin, ST, M.Cs; "Keamanan Teknologi Informasi Dampak dan Ancaman Bagi NKRI" by Kolonel Arh Syarif Hidayatullah; "Pentester Diary: Journey to Become UID (Linux Hacking)" by Ahmad Muammar W.K, OSCP, OSCE; and "Fun with ELF: Reverse-Engineering On *nix Machine" by Nurkholish Halim.

node.title: IDSECCONF 2012 - Konferensi Keamanan Komputer Nasional V
node.description: IDSECCONF came to Makassar for the first time with the theme "Teknik Keamanan dan Penerapannya pada Teknologi Mobile", where COCONUT Computer Club members took part in organizing the event together with the local Makassar hacker community. The conference was attended by more than 400 participants and featured talks by Onno W. Purbo and a Capture The Flag (CTF) competition.

node.title: Workshop Raspberry Pi - It's Raspberry Not Blackberry..!!
node.description: A free Raspberry Pi workshop organized by COCONUT Computer Club, supported by STMIK Profesional Makassar with The MagPi as media partner. The session covered an introduction to Raspberry Pi, programming with Python, GPIO interfacing, and Raspbian installation, opened with a talk on microcontroller technology by Tasrif Hasanuddin, ST, M.Cs, and hands-on training by Ucog Sinaga, S.Kom and Nurkholish Halim, S.SI.

node.title: Seminar & Workshop Membuat Website Dengan Mudah Menggunakan Berbagai CMS
node.description: A seminar and workshop on building websites easily using various CMS such as Joomla, Drupal, vBulletin, and phpBB, presented by Nurkholish Halim and Yusuf Yacob Onaola. Topics covered web design basics (HTML), CMS installation, building websites and community forums, installing templates, modules, components, and plugins, plus an introduction to web security. Participants received a certificate, a CD containing CMS packages and templates, snacks, and workshop modules.

node.title: SCAN TO COMPILE 01 - Penerimaan Calon Anggota Baru + Workshop Merakit PC
node.description: COCONUT Computer Club's first event: a new member recruitment combined with a PC assembly workshop, held for all students of AMIK Profesional Makassar.
